title: The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical safety and cybersecurity of computer-use agents (CUAs), specifically evaluating vulnerabilities to malware, phishing, and data theft. It characterizes 'harm' based on system security and acceptable-use policies rather than evaluating religion, moral reasoning, or philosophical ethics.
